title: Idiopathic Central Precocious Puberty and Associated Neurodevelopmental Syndromes and Pathologies: Evaluation of Frequency and Comparison of Diagnostic and Developmental Characteristics
official: Idiopathic Central Precocious Puberty and Associated Neurodevelopmental Syndromes and Pathologies: Evaluation of Frequency and Comparison of Diagnostic and Developmental Characteristics
summary: Observational, retrosopective, single-centre, non-profit study focused on the frequency of Central Precocious Puberty idiopathic, or associated to Neurodevelopmental Syndromes and Pathologies, and comparison of diagnostic and developmental characteristics of patients.
